message: No detected input validation: While there are basic checks for empty strings (intent=='' and pattern==''), there is no schema validation, type checking, length limits, or sanitization of user-supplied text before it is processed or stored in the database.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local pickle/model files and a local SQLite database; no remote sources are fetched, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on the local files loaded (e.g., the pickle embeddings file).
No detected label flipping detection: The code performs no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected label set, or use of any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained embeddings via pickle and models via keras load_model with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before use.

No detected label distribution validation: The code computes class weights via sklearn's compute_class_weight for loss balancing, but performs no explicit validation or check of label distribution, expected label set, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The training code uses standard Keras/Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) integrated.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train-test split is performed, there is no held-out isolation enforced programmatically, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no multiple independent metrics logged; the same LabelEncoder/OneHotEncoder is fit inside PrepareData without ensuring test labels are encoded only from training fit

No detected input sanitization: User input is only lowercased, stripped of whitespace, and collapsed spaces — there are no shape/range checks, schema validation, length limits, or rejection of malformed inputs before passing to PredictClass or PredictNer.
No detected output bounds checks: The code uses the model outputs (intent label, NER entities) directly without any probability threshold checks, NaN guards, or confidence-score validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it uses a shallow CNN classifier and NER model, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
